themes.name: Agentic AI research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents performing tasks and research autonomously, their capabilities, limitations, and applications in various domains.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers tools and research related to AI that helps developers write, review, and debug code.

themes.name: AI for product research
themes.description: Explores how AI is being applied to various aspects of product development, from ingredient research to go-to-market growth.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the use of AI chatbots in research, including their impact on user behavior and potential for misinformation.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Addresses the creation and use of synthetic data or personas for AI research and testing, along with concerns about authenticity.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Discusses platforms and tools that leverage AI to enhance research capabilities across different industries.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a variety of AI-powered tools designed to assist in research processes and data analysis.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is used to analyze and understand user sentiment from feedback and social media.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Explores the application of AI for summarizing large amounts of text and data into concise insights.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Examines the intersection of AI with design processes and user research methodologies.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
